note: Starting assumptions for the test app. Values marked verify must be checked before public testing.

rate_per_kwh.label: Electricity rate used when your kWh is not entered (PHP per kWh)
rate_per_kwh.source: Meralco typical-household rate, Oct 2026 (news reports of Meralco's rate advisory). Other provider types: rough estimates - enter your own bill figures.

avoidable_share.label: Share of the per-kWh rate you avoid for each solar kWh you use yourself
avoidable_share.source: Assumption: most bill components are charged per kWh; some fixed charges remain.

export_credit_per_kwh.label: Net-metering credit for each kWh sent to the grid (PHP per kWh)
export_credit_per_kwh.source: Assumption: net-metering exports are credited at roughly the utility's blended generation charge.

self_use_share.label: Share of your electricity used during sunny hours

m2_per_kwp.label: Roof area needed per kW of panels, including spacing (m2)
m2_per_kwp.source: Assumption for modern 450-600 W panels with access space.

cost_per_kwp_php.label: Installed cost per kW, grid-tie (PHP)
cost_per_kwp_php.source: Grid-tie: installer price examples (about PHP 44-52 per watt) and Ember's PHP 60 per watt model assumption, 2026. Hybrid and off-grid: rough assumptions.

fixed_charges_php.label: Part of the monthly bill that solar cannot reduce (PHP)
